lines.text: At midnight the LORD struck down every firstborn male in Egypt, and there was loud wailing in every house.
Pharaoh summoned Moses and Aaron by night and told them to leave and take their flocks and herds.
The people took their dough before it was leavened and carried it on their shoulders in kneading bowls.
The Israelites journeyed from Rameses to Bethel with about 600,000 men on foot, besides women and children.
The Israelites stayed in Egypt 480 years, and on the very day those years ended, the LORD's divisions left.
